UserMessage.text: Report the current system: OS, CPU cores, and RAM. Do not use tools.

AssistantText.text: I don't have access to real-time system information or the ability to execute commands to retrieve OS, CPU, and RAM details. My knowledge is based on training data up to 2024, and I can't interact with your local environment directly. You'll need to check your system specifications through tools like `uname -a`, `nproc`, or `free -h` in a terminal.
